title: MP4 checks (the verify measurements)
what_it_does: Measures the rendered file: duration and frame rate, first frame, blank, frozen, near-empty and still stretches, cuts on the beat, transition variety against the ledger, poster frame, on-screen numbers against the brief, audio presence and loudness; writes per-shot frames for the critic and five moments for the human. A check that could not run is reported as skipped, never as passed.
when_to_use: Before every delivery. The verify skill runs it and reads the report; do not call a video done without it.

source.repo: create-video-engine (ideas: loudness from lemo-opuscar and motion-video-kit, numbers from open-edit, variety from saas-motion-kit, poster from brag, moments from Barty-Bart; all MIT, own code)

notes: One card for the whole group: the checks share one report and one set of thresholds, so they are installed together. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
